title: Colour comes back where the lines have been

plate.vf_note: Lossless: stores the portrait clip rotated into a 16:9 frame; the page rotates it back and composes a portrait strip (frame.*) plus a blurred side panel. Not a crop.
plate.label: FOOTAGE: Prusa Core One (right) and a second printer (left), phone pulling back
plate.sub: REAL · printer_2_side_by_side.mp4 from 1.2 s · portrait strip left, blurred panel right

frame.note: s = portrait width on screen / 1080 px; (cx, cy) = point of the portrait (0..1) put at screen centre. Anchors are in this pre-push screen space; change s/cx/cy and the anchors must move too.

anchor_note: x, y = screen centre of the real printer body (enclosure top to its bottom edge); h = its on-screen height in px. The hologram's bounding box is fitted to that. yaw/pitch = extra camera degrees on the model (beat 0 rest is yaw 28, pitch 16). rot = in-plane degrees.

q.text:
How does a 3D printer
build things?

a.text:
It draws one slice
at a time.

honest.text: Visualised. On the glasses it's a panel in your view.

cues.sound: room tone + printer hum, low-passed (grey world)
thin rising tone starts under the scan line, rises to 3.8
small high chime as the build tops out
low soft whoosh with the line echo; open the low-pass on the hum
warm music swell as colour fills the room
cut on the beat into the next shot
